description: This file defines the NotesRepository class which interfaces with NoteDao to perform CRUD and search operations on Note data entities, serving as a data repository layer in an Android application.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to access and modify Note data via NoteDao.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a Flow stream of all notes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function to get a Note by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Suspending function to insert a new Note and return its ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns a Flow stream of notes matching the search query.
